thread:
Priya (oncall): ops-bot just paged me — multiple 502s from VPC inference gateway in us-west-2. Noticing spike ~10:23 UTC. Investigating. :rotating_light:

ops-bot: Incident detected: service=inference-gateway region=us-west-2 symptom=502_rate(>5%) severity=high pager=oncall-priya

Evan: seeing same. Errors from gateway -> backend pool. Error rate on the routing tier up to 18% in last 2m.

Maya: I can confirm increased latencies on hosted API too, but lower magnitude. Could be routing fallback loop.

Priya (oncall): quick customer impact check — please call out Dedicated/private customers and any SLA-exposed tenants. Jordan, can you pull list from routing logs?

Jordan (SRE): pulling now. Early read: ~12 customers affected, 3 Dedicated tenants (acme-corp, finflux, medscan). Error pattern: 502s come back from the internal vproxy when backend returns TCP reset. Suspect overloaded vproxy worker due to bad KV cache eviction pattern.

Evan: adding mitigation attempts: 1) temporarily route traffic away from unhealthy vproxies 2) increase worker threads on gateway (hot patch) 3) roll backend variant to older kernel. Which is lowest risk?

Priya (oncall): prioritize routing and worker threads first. We'll avoid roll for now. 1) Update routing policy to skip gateway nodes with >5% 502 for 5m. ops-bot, can you run the routing policy change?

ops-bot: Routing policy change queued by Priya. Change ID: rp-20260315-01. Will apply in 30s and report.

Maya: applying worker thread bump on 3 nodes. Patching one at a time, canary first.

Jordan (SRE): found correlated increase in KV cache churn for long-context requests from acme-corp. Could be a prompt pattern hitting a bug in cache expiry. Temporary mitigation: enable prefix-KV cache bypass for those tenants.

Priya (oncall): good. Jordan, can you prepare tenant-level bypass list and a short customer notification we can paste into Zendesk/Intercom? Support Team Bot, stand by to send templated reply once approved.

Jordan (SRE): draft notification (internal quickcopy):
```
Short: We're investigating increased 502 errors impacting inference requests in us-west-2. We're routing traffic away from affected gateway nodes and applying worker fixes. Some requests may see transient errors or higher latency. We'll update within 30 minutes.

Customer-facing (Zendesk/Intercom):
Hi {customer_name},

We're currently investigating intermittent 502 errors affecting model inference requests in our us-west-2 region. Our engineers have identified and are routing traffic away from affected gateway nodes and applying mitigations. You may see transient failed requests or increased latency. We do not believe data integrity is affected. We'll post updates here when we have more information and expected resolution time.

If you rely on Dedicated capacity, please reply and we'll engage your account engineer.

Thanks,
Redwood Support
```

Maya: that looks fine. Minor edit: add "we will not restart your jobs without consent" for Dedicated.

Jordan (SRE): updated.

Priya (oncall): Support Team Bot — please queue the Intercom/Zendesk macro using Jordan's text. Use tag: INCIDENT-USW2-502. Include internal note linking to incident timeline.

Support Team Bot: Macro INCIDENT-USW2-502 created by Priya. Ready for agents.

Evan: mitigation progress — routing change applied, error rate dropped from 18% -> 6% in 90s. Worker thread bump applied to canary node, no regressions.

Priya (oncall): great. Jordan, please prepare the status page blurb (public) and a short internal postmortem template we can paste into #postmortems later.

Jordan (SRE): Status page (public):
"Partial service disruption in us-west-2 affecting inference requests. Root cause under investigation; traffic routed away from affected gateway nodes. Some requests may experience errors or increased latency. We're actively mitigating and will provide updates"

Internal postmortem template (quick):
- Incident ID: INCIDENT-1712004321
- Start: 2026-03-15T10:23:41Z
- Impact: 502 errors causing failed inference for ~12 customers, 3 Dedicated tenants; customers saw transient failures and elevated latency.
- Timeline: (populate)
- Root cause hypothesis: cache eviction churn causing vproxy worker overload -> TCP resets
- Mitigations: routing bypass, worker thread bump, tenant-level KV cache bypass
- Next steps: add circuit-breaker for vproxy resets, improve cache eviction logging, automated per-tenant bypass runbook

Priya (oncall): good. Also create a quick support troubleshooting checklist for agents to triage incoming tickets. Jordan, can you drop a compact checklist here we can paste into the Support KB?

Jordan (SRE): Support troubleshooting checklist (agent-friendly):
1) Confirm region and timestamp from customer request. Ask for request_id or request logs.
2) Check status page and incident tags: INCIDENT-USW2-502.
3) If Dedicated tenant, escalate to AE and add internal note "Dedicated-impacted".
4) Run quick curl to endpoint and capture response code. Example: `curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H \"Authorization: Bearer <key>\"`
5) If 502: capture gateway node id from `x-rw-node` header in response, paste into incident thread.
6) If intermittent: advise customer we are routing around affected nodes and to retry with exponential backoff.
7) For urgent Dedicated production jobs: offer manual routing to healthy pool (requires AE signoff).

Priya (oncall): perfect. I'll sign off on the status page update. ops-bot, publish status page entry and pin this thread.

ops-bot: Status page updated: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-1712004321. Thread pinned in #incidents.

Evan: routing kept errors <5% for the last 10m. Closing mitigation loop. Recommend monitoring for 45m before severity downgrade.

Priya (oncall): agree. Assign follow-up tasks: Jordan to run root-cause for cache churn, Maya to validate worker autoscaling rules, Evan to fine-tune routing SLO thresholds. Add these to incident board.

Support Team Bot: Automated note for tickets referencing INCIDENT-USW2-502: "This ticket pertains to an ongoing partial service disruption in us-west-2. For Dedicated customers, a support engineer will follow up. For updates see https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-1712004321."

Priya (oncall): handing off to night shift oncall @Maya. I'm writing the post-incident owner list and will draft follow-up once RCA is ready. Handoff summary pasted to #eng-oncall.

Maya: thanks — taking over monitoring. Will post update if anything regresses. :thumbsup:

Jordan (SRE): I'll post an initial RCA draft by EOD and a Support KB entry with the checklist and the two macros.

Priya (oncall): thanks team — great coordination.
